scamshield.ui.title: Scam Shield
scamshield.flag.reward: A reward too good to be true
scamshield.flag.authority: Someone posing as the police or a bank
scamshield.flag.small_trust_payment: A small payment to unlock big money
scamshield.scenario.upiRefund.message: Your UPI payment of ₹2,000 failed. Please accept this Collect Request to get your refund immediately.
scamshield.scenario.upiRefund.tell: Refunds never require you to enter your UPI PIN. A collect request means money is going OUT of your account.
scamshield.scenario.qrScanReceive.messag: Congratulations! You won ₹5,000. Scan this QR code and enter your PIN to receive the prize money in your account.
scamshield.scenario.qrScanReceive.tell: Scanning a QR code and entering a PIN is ONLY for sending money, never for receiving.
scamshield.scenario.fakeTask.message: Earn ₹2,000 daily by liking videos. Deposit a ₹500 registration fee to unlock your first task.
scamshield.scenario.fakeTask.tell: A real job pays you; it does not ask you to pay first. This is a task scam.
scamshield.scenario.instantLoan.message: Pre-approved loan of ₹50,000! Download this app now. We do not check your credit score. Offer expires in 10 minutes.
scamshield.scenario.instantLoan.tell: Fake loan apps copy your contacts and photos and use them to threaten you later.
scamshield.scenario.kycExpires.message: Dear customer, your bank account will be blocked today due to pending KYC. Click here to update: http://bank-kyc-verify.example
scamshield.scenario.kycExpires.tell: A bank does not threaten to block you through a link in a message. The link opens a fake login page.
scamshield.scenario.digitalArrest.messag: (Call from a "customs officer") Your parcel contains illegal items. You are under digital arrest. Pay a ₹50,000 security deposit to clear your name.
scamshield.scenario.digitalArrest.tell: There is no such thing as a "digital arrest". The police never ask for a deposit to clear your name.
scamshield.scenario.doubleMoney.message: Double your money in 25 days! Guaranteed returns from expert traders. Message us to join the VIP group.
scamshield.scenario.doubleMoney.tell: If they could double money, they would not need yours. "Guaranteed returns" is a warning sign every time.
scamshield.scenario.tipsGroup.message: Join my VIP chat group. Pay ₹2,000 for 100% accurate share tips. Do not miss tomorrow's big winner!
scamshield.scenario.tipsGroup.tell: Selling tips without being registered is illegal. The tipster buys first, then uses you to push the price up.
scamshield.scenario.scholarshipFee.messa: You are selected for the National Merit Scholarship of ₹50,000. Pay ₹250 processing fee to our bank account to release funds.
scamshield.scenario.scholarshipFee.tell: Government scholarships do not ask for an upfront processing fee to a personal bank account.
scamshield.scenario.genuineBank.message: A/c *1234 debited by INR 500.00 on 10-Oct. Available Bal: INR 12,500.00. Call 1800-XXX-XXXX if not done by you.
scamshield.scenario.genuineBank.tell: A genuine bank alert. It asks you to click nothing and pay nothing.
scamshield.scenario.genuineUpi.message: Paid ₹150 to "Raju Store" via UPI. UPI Ref: 123456789.
scamshield.scenario.genuineUpi.tell: An ordinary confirmation of a payment you just made at a shop.
scamshield.scenario.genuineScholarship.m: Application received. Please check the status of your scholarship on the official portal: scholarships.gov.in.
scamshield.scenario.genuineScholarship.t: It points you to a government portal (.gov.in) you can check yourself, and asks for no money or password.
scamshield.scenario.genuineTax.message: Your Income Tax Return for AY 25-26 has been processed. Check your status at incometax.gov.in.
scamshield.scenario.genuineTax.tell: An ordinary government notice. It tells you to visit the official site yourself and carries no link to tap.
scamshield.checkIt.title: The five-point check
scamshield.checkIt.q1: Is it registered with SEBI, RBI or IRDAI?
scamshield.checkIt.q3: Does the money go to a company account, not a personal UPI ID?
scamshield.checkIt.q4: Is there a clear, easy way to take your money out?
scamshield.checkIt.q5: Could you explain how it works to a friend?
scamshield.checkIt.verdictSafe: No warning signs in these five checks. Still confirm it on the regulator's official site before any money moves.
scamshield.checkIt.verdictStop: More than one "no": stop. Do not pay, and talk to a trusted adult.
scamshield.nowWhat.title: I have been scammed. Now what?
scamshield.nowWhat.step1_desc: Pay nothing more. Block the scammer.
scamshield.nowWhat.step2_desc: Use the bank's official number and ask them to freeze the account or card.
scamshield.nowWhat.step3_desc: This is the national cybercrime helpline. Acting fast can freeze the stolen money.
scamshield.nowWhat.step4_desc: Take screenshots of the chats, payment receipts and links.
scamshield.nowWhat.step6_desc: Do not let shame keep you silent. A trusted adult can help you through the next steps.
scamshield.ui.intro: Read each message. Decide: is it a scam, or does it look fine? Some of these are real messages.
scamshield.ui.resultAll: Every message read correctly. The habit to keep: pause, check the sender, and never pay to receive.
scamshield.ui.resultSome: Each miss here cost nothing. Look again at the warning signs, then play another round.
scamshield.ui.shieldTotal: Your scam safety so far: {{correct}} right out of {{seen}} seen. It counts towards your Money Health Score.
scamshield.checkIt.intro: Run these five checks before any money leaves your account.
scamshield.checkIt.verdictCareful: One "no": slow down. Find the answer to that question before any money moves.
scamshield.checkIt.pending: Answer all five to see the result.
scamshield.nowWhat.intro: Speed matters more than anything else. Do these in order.
